apps.name: AnimeToGMD
apps.short_description:
Anime to GD (A2GD) is a conversion tool for Geometry Dash.
It allows you to convert videos and images directly into the game using a vector approach to minimize objects (no AI).

apps.name: Bot Creator Studio
apps.short_description: Design, automate, and deploy bots seamlessly. With a visual block builder, and full scripting power, Bot Creator Studio brings command design, live monitoring, and hosting into a unified workspace—locally on your PC or 24/7 in the cloud.

apps.name: Desktop+
apps.short_description: Desktop+ is a utility application for SteamVR enabling you advanced access to your desktops and windows from within VR. Pull your screen into the VR world, attach windows to your controllers, view 3D content, and more.

apps.name: RPG Soundboard
apps.short_description: RPG Soundboard is an audio companion for tabletop RPG game masters, featuring a user interface designed for easier, live playback. Load your own music and sound effects, organize them across multiple soundboards and playlists, and increase the immersion of your table.
publishers: Luiz  Felipe Romero de Azevedo (indie solo dev)

apps.name: Screenbits - Screen Recorder
apps.short_description: Fast, flexible, and easy-to-use screen recorder for gameplay, tutorials, product demos, and more. Record your screen, system audio, microphone, and camera in high-quality HD or 4K with smooth performance.

apps.name: Walton's Window Sitters
apps.short_description: Simple desktop customizer that's not distracting, low on resource use, and extremely simple to use. Upload a gif, APNG, or just a static image and make your desktop feel even more like yours!

apps.name: Urine Trouble: PEE V PEE ™ Playtest
Ashikai Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening hour of Ashikai, a dark fantasy isometric action RPG set in yōkai-cursed feudal Japan. Begin Matsuo Shinro's journey, master precise katana combat, take on quests, and enter the first dungeon.

apps.name: BARD'S FAULT Demo
apps.short_description: Bard’s Fault is a co-op Action Roguelike where you and your friends fight back-to-back against relentless swarms. Craft new builds, sync your abilities, and break the timeline in this multiplayer bullet heaven. Death is just the beginning, go back to the past and unravel a time-travel mystery.

apps.name: Bullet Glory Demo
apps.short_description: Play Bullet Glory’s Circuit with the Arrow: three neon stages, their bosses and every difficulty. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Chain-Chillas Demo
apps.short_description: A 3D marble rolling game where you're chained to your friends!

apps.name: Corsair Cove Demo
apps.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

apps.name: Crash Cut Demo
apps.short_description: A voxel rally where every wall is a shortcut and every car a target. Punch car-sized holes through houses, barns and brick walls, ram the pack off the road, and race a six-round knockout to the title, or take one battered hull through a roguelite run.

apps.name: Dead Sector Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

apps.name: Deadzone Cleanup Crew Demo
apps.short_description: In this incremental game, scavenge scrap, upgrade your base, hire survivors, and clear zombie-infested zones in Deadzone Cleanup Crew, a click-to-clear game with escalating waves, bosses, and big satisfying numbers!

apps.name: Deal Me In Demo
apps.short_description: A PS1-inspired casino horror roguelike. Play slots and draw poker, open upgrade packs, pay your growing debt, and escape the Backrooms. Survive six days on Easy in this single-player demo of Deal Me In.

apps.name: Death Howl Demo
apps.short_description: Journey the sorrowful spirit world in soulslike deck builder, Death Howl. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

apps.name: DELTA // SURGE Demo
apps.short_description: DELTA // SURGE is an action roguelike bullet hell shooter with deckbuilding. Draft cards mid-run, fight 30 waves of enemy fleets and bosses, and unlock new Flight Frames and permanent upgrades to push your next run further.

apps.name: Desktop Factory Demo
apps.short_description: Drill deep while you work or game in a zero-stress factory builder for the side of your screen or second monitor. Power your drill, unlock alternate building shapes, and master compact layouts as you harvest the galaxy. The. Factory. Must. Grow.

apps.name: Draco and the Seven Scales Demo
apps.short_description: Set sail on a voyage full of pirates, dark magic, and the thrill of discovery! Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that harkens back to an age of top down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art.

apps.name: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

apps.name: Figure Drawing Garden Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden — an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

apps.name: GODBREAKERS Demo
apps.short_description: Take control of every fight with ferociously fluid combat as you chain aggressive combos, cancel moves mid-swing, and steal enemy powers to turn them against their masters. Play in up to 4-player co-op to craft the perfect team setup and topple brutal bosses across different worlds.

apps.name: Gravelix Demo
apps.short_description: Try Gravelix for free: blocks shatter into gravel on landing, and same-colored gravel that reaches from one side of the board to the other explodes. The demo includes the interactive tutorial and Classic mode with 5-minute sessions limitation.

apps.name: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder Demo
apps.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

apps.name: Hustle Together Demo
apps.short_description: Hustle together is a top down space action-RPG for 1-4 players.  Hustle for bling by scavenging, salvaging, hunting and trading.  Spend bling on upgrades for your ship, or over 100 upgradeable weapons.

apps.name: Idle Ascent Demo
apps.short_description: Your party fights in a corner of your desktop while you work or play something else. Pick four heroes from six classes, shape their skills and chase loot that grants new passives. Climb the Eternal Tower and claim a wish that could send you home.

apps.name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM Episode One Demo
apps.short_description:
"The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..."

KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

apps.name: Magical Princess Demo
apps.short_description: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

apps.name: Mall Chaos Demo
apps.short_description: Your shift starts when the mall closes. Explore shoe shops, cosmetics stores, and sports shops in Mall Chaos Demo. Pick up scattered products, carry them through the aisles, and return them to the right displays in this first-person tidying game.

apps.name: MENACE Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a strike force against an alien threat in this turn-based tactical RPG from the developers of Battle Brothers. Answer distress calls across different worlds, train and equip infantry, deploy tanks and mechs, and plan and execute missions in detailed turn-based battles.

apps.name: Pinhead Adventures Demo
apps.short_description: Swing, blast, and grapple your way around in the Pinhead Adventures DEMO! The Zino is Zortan's very own Casino! Spin the Slots! Gather the coins! Spawn ferocious enemies. Get powerful in this randomized sandbox! Solve puzzles? Easy! Experience low gravity in the Pinhead Adventures DEMO! Play Today!

apps.name: Pizzapoly Demo
apps.short_description: PIZZAPOLY Demo is a chaotic co-op restaurant game where you run your own pizzeria with friends. Prepare pizzas, serve tables, handle online orders, hop on your scooter for deliveries, and survive the rush together.

apps.name: PluggedInCats Demo
apps.short_description: Demo — Battery running low! Place the cats and route their cables with care to charge every device and keep these internet-loving kitties exploring the digital world!

apps.name: Pocket Ocean Demo
apps.short_description: Sway your mermaid fin and dive towards the lake bed to collect pretty pebbles! Customize your merperson, upgrade your skills, trade with trinket-obsessed crows and explore the waters. Dock the game in the corner of your screen so it can keep you company  as you do other things!

apps.name: Pocket TD Demo
apps.short_description: Try Pocket TD free: a tower defense game on a map that grows as you play. Play the tutorial and a full Expedition with four towers, and bring your XP and unlocks to the full game.

apps.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart Demo
apps.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

apps.name: ROBOSCAV Demo
apps.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

apps.name: Ruptured Floor Demo
apps.short_description: Dive into a surreal and dark office space made of distorted floors. Traverse them all, one at the time, to find an exit. Ruptured Floor is a horror puzzle game with a unique twist. Every floor requires a combination to open the door. The code is known. The lock, however, will need to be found.

apps.name: Scraplings Demo
apps.short_description: Build a cozy, hand-drawn factory on an endless sea of trash. Dig up scrap, lay belts, power your machines and turn yesterday's garbage into orders worth paying the rent with. This free demo covers your first seven days on the junk sea.

apps.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine Demo
apps.short_description: Spend a summer evening at an old captain’s house on the Maine coast. Explore the house and shore, fish from the dock, and collect sea glass as daylight fades into blue hour. Stay as long as you like.

apps.name: Survivors Under Siege Demo
apps.short_description: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

apps.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon Demo
apps.short_description: Step into a dark reimagination of Arthurian legends in this first person, open world RPG. Explore a world stuck in everlasting autumn, witness falling legends and make meaningful choices woven into a complex, branching storyline.

apps.name: Time Stop Tower Defense Demo
apps.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

apps.name: Tungsteel Demo
apps.short_description: Build deadly mech squads in a single-player autobattler with a turn-based strategy map. Combine abilities, set target priorities, and cut enemy supply lines. Capture resources to repair, rearm, and unlock new mechs as you push toward the enemy base.

apps.name: TurtleSkate Demo
apps.short_description: Skate as a turtle, complete objectives, avoid entities, and escape. 1-5 player co-op horror.

apps.name: Yaarmi Tycoon Demo
apps.short_description: Play Yaarmi's first day for free: the tutorial in his messy bedroom and the whole first studio. Buy gear, upgrade every part, complete missions and watch your income grow in this cozy idle tycoon. Progress is saved. 7 languages.

apps.name: You Remembered Demo
apps.short_description: Type letters that fall and become part of the world. Use their shape and attributes to navigate the puzzles and secrets.

apps.name: Токарь: Ночная Смена Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person lathe simulator. Work the night shift: control speed and feed, machine parts to drawings, check dimensions and complete jobs. Smoke breaks, alcohol and a sharp-tongued mentor liven up the routine, while carelessness leads to injuries and fires.

apps.name: 我的幸福人生 Demo
apps.short_description: Kevin dies in a car crash and wakes up in a strange new world filled with gentle wives, cool mature women, and cute girls. He also meets many beauties—teachers, doctors, police officers, nurses, and streamers. Can he find happiness in this new life?

apps.name: 敏感！恋のアンテナ ビンビン別嬪荘 Demo
apps.short_description:
Co-produced by TV Asahi and Aiming, this “drama-level” live-action romance game lets you experience a year of love, laughter, and longing.
Decode the subtle signals of affection and create your own unforgettable love story.

apps.name: 老板说问题不大 Demo
apps.short_description: 睁开眼，面前是一张符纸，一条闹鬼的巷子，一个委托，以及…一位不靠谱的无良老板。躲藏、交涉、收集线索，在谎言中寻找真相，诙谐与惊悚交织。当死亡也成为武器，一次次带着轮回的记忆重新来过，而这次，你走向的结局是…？

apps.name: 音序核心 Demo
apps.short_description: Groove Core is a rhythm-based bullet heaven roguelike shooter where you arrange your weapons on a sequencer. Mix and match 200+ items, build your ship, and flood the cosmos with bullet storms as deadly as they are beautiful.

apps.name: Borderlands®4 - Story Pack 2: FL4K and the Last Resort
apps.short_description: Fight alongside FL4K to hunt down Tediore forces invading the tropical island of Providence! This wild adventure features new missions, activities, loot, and a lush new region.

apps.name: Bureau Clerk Goes Berserk! [An Additional Lap of the Gods Tale]
apps.short_description: After the events of Lap of the Gods: A Visual Novel, Beau the Bureau Clerk is recovering from her buggy incident. But when Marion calls up Beau to apologize and offers a date, how could Beau possibly say no?! Join Beau as she gets ready for a fun-filled night with the one and only Marion! 💜

apps.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® II - DMZ Beta
apps.short_description: Fight against players and AI enemies as you pick a hitlist of missions with your squad. Once you’ve hit your limit, find a chopper and exfil to safety - or fight to be the squad that claims the final ride out.

apps.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core - Supporter Upgrade
apps.short_description: Want to go the extra mile to support the developers of Rogue Core? And look golden doing so? This DLC is your way of putting a couple bucks in the ol’ tip jar at Ghost Ship Games. It gives you some shiny in-game goodies too, as our way of saying thanks. Classic win-win situation if you ask us.

apps.name: Dying Light - Hellraid
apps.short_description: The final Hellraid update is coming, bringing a number of tweaks and improvements to your dungeon experience!

apps.name: Expantion pack
apps.short_description: Shampoo have evolved to make 2 new classes an a bunce of new cards, but then BOOM 3 virus have come to destroy signs and shampoo alike

apps.name: FOR HONOR - Hero Skin - Warmonger
apps.short_description: With the Hero Skin of Conquistador Vela, return to Heathmoor as a Horkos victor, the doom of a stolen empire.

apps.name: Grim Dawn - Steam Loyalist 2 DLC
apps.short_description: Whether you're an old fan or just purchasing Grim Dawn, this fantasy-themed collection of vanity items allows you to bring out the classic fantasy hero within you. The items in this DLC can be applied to existing gear to transform the look while retaining the original stats.

apps.name: Grim Dawn - Steam Loyalist Upgrade
apps.short_description: Whether you're an old fan or just purchasing Grim Dawn, this fun collection of vanity items allows you to outfit your character with a little extra flourish. The historically themed items can be applied to existing gear to transform the look while retaining the original stats.

apps.name: Herbal Apothecary Tea Pinball
apps.short_description: Take command of Zeppelin Pinball! Explore richly detailed airship cabins, decode secret orders, conquer sweeping ramps, and unleash thrilling multiball in a cinematic wartime adventure packed with classic silver-ball action.

apps.name: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Woodburn Weapon Skin Set
apps.short_description: Bring a touch of timeless elegance to your arsenal and embrace the charm of classic wood weapons with the Woodburn Weapon Skin Set for Insurgents. This skin can be applied to six different weapons.

apps.name: LEGO® Worlds: Showcase Collection Pack One
apps.short_description: Feeling left out because you missed the AWESOMELY FREE content we released on the showcase in 2017? Don't worry. We've got you covered!

apps.name: Monster Hunter Wilds - Layered Charge Blade: Cosmoloid Arms
apps.short_description: A Layered Weapon with a sleek, futuristic, high-tech design that changes when being held.

apps.name: Monster Hunter Wilds - Pendant: Felyne Mint Chocolate
apps.short_description: A pendant that looks like a chocolate mint ice cream Felyne.

apps.name: Nioh 3 Hell Rising
apps.short_description: A new open field, Edo in the Keian period, and new weapons take Nioh 3 to even greater heights!

apps.name: Pioneers of Pagonia - Meadowsong
apps.short_description: Experience the story of the island »Meadowsong«. Once known for their thriving agriculture, the harvest of Meadowsong is haunted by a mysterious Withering destroying everything. Build new production chains with fruits, wine and livestock, and help to solve the mystery of the witches' coven.

apps.name: Prince of Persia The Lost Crown - Mask of Darkness
apps.short_description:
Experience a new story around Radjen, the assassin of the Immortals, as she traps Sargon in her Mind Palace, a nightmarish dimension created with her dark magic.
Explore four biomes filled with new platforming elements, new lethal foes to face, and three epic bosses.

apps.name: SOS OPS! - OVERBOOKED
apps.short_description: OVERBOOKED is a DLC for SOS OPS! that adds a new co-op flight scenario for up to 4 players. Prepare the plane, load baggage, seat passengers, handle in-flight problems, fly the aircraft and land safely together.

apps.name: Supporter+
apps.short_description: Shampoo quality of life brought in a small bundle

apps.name: Tea Garden Pinball
apps.short_description: 🏗️ Build towering skyscrapers, operate giant cranes, smash through demolition zones, and conquer steel ramps, spinners, bumpers, and drop targets! 🚜🔨 Trigger explosive multiball action, complete massive construction projects, and score huge jackpots in this heavy-duty pinball adventure!

apps.name: TEKKEN 8 - Kunimitsu
apps.short_description: The Enchanted Thief - Kunimitsu the Second is joining the fight!

apps.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Plus Membership
apps.short_description: Become an ESO Plus member to unlock brand-new seasonal benefits, increased progression, a Crown Store stipend, and more!

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 1
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: Dallas, San Antonio and Miami skylines, Acorn Street in Boston, Bryce Canyon in snow and empty roads across the prairie. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 2
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: the New River Gorge Bridge, Manhattan from above, the Biloxi lighthouse, a mountain town in the fall and desert arches. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 3
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: El Capitan, the Painted Hills, the Big Sur coast, a barn below the Tetons, Charleston and Las Vegas from above. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 4
apps.short_description: 16 more pictures of the USA for United States of America Jigsaw Puzzles: an old mill above the falls, golden leaves in a brick alley, Zion's river, the Austin and Tampa skylines and Atlanta at sunset. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: WARDOGS - Movember Pack
apps.short_description: Grow a Mustache for charity! WARDOGS is teaming up with Movember to support men's health. Grab the Tactical ‘Stache DLC, grow your moustache as you play throughout November, and unlock a permanent Movember 2026 scoreboard badge. 100% of profits from this DLC go to Movember.

apps.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Arbites Class Cosmetic Upgrade
apps.short_description: You are justice. The Adeptus Arbites enforce the Lex Imperialis – the Imperial Law. Utterly unforgiving, they persecute heretics and traitors throughout the Emperor’s realm. Restore order to Tertium with your Cyber-Mastiff and a devastating array of new weaponry.

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Carbon Weapon Skins
apps.short_description: Yes, it comes in black! Apply a carbon look to your guns with these weapon skins

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Flags Charm Pack
apps.short_description: Let the undead know who sent you! With these flag charms, you can add some patriotic spirit to your guns!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Gas Mask Headgear Bundle
apps.short_description: Now that the legions of the undead have laid waste to Europe, fears of poisonous gasses are a thing of the past. However, the masks themselves have been repurposed as protective headgear

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Left 4 Dead Character Pack 1
apps.short_description: The four characters from Left 4 Dead join the Resistance in this free Character Pack!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Wehrmacht P08 Pistol Bundle
apps.short_description: It’s time to bring a new meaning to ‘point and shoot!’ One of the most accurate guns ever made, this semi-automatic pistol has a fearsome reputation for a reason!

apps.name: Zombie Army 4: Wrapping Paper Weapon Skins
apps.short_description: Give the undead hordes the gift of destruction! Apply a wrapping paper look to your guns with these weapon skins.

apps.name: 10 Million Stones
apps.short_description: This game is being rebuilt from the ground up. A new name, new visuals and a full description will be posted here when they are ready.

apps.name: 85Top
apps.short_description:
85Top is an arcade racing game inspired by Crazy Taxi, with the fast pace of Need for Speed ​​and the heat of downtown Fortaleza!
Pick up passengers, compete with other app drivers, earn money and get a 5-star rating — all this with passing through historic landmarks in the city.

apps.name: A Week to Remember
apps.short_description: Help Elliot recover his memories and unlock the truth of what happened before it's too late. A Mexican-American gothic, boys' love visual novel, featuring interactive spell crafting and point-and-click exploration.

apps.name: Alex's Journey to the Grave
apps.short_description: Two people meet in a strange, critical moment; changing their lives forever. An intimate visual novel exploring the nature of love, fate, tragedy, and the will to live on.

apps.name: Americana: The Dead Years
apps.short_description: Fight zombies and hostile survivors in a first-person voxel survival sandbox. Scavenge fallen towns, repair vehicles and smash through destructible buildings. Build a home, rebuild bridges, hunt, fish and farm to stay alive.

apps.name: Anomaly Planet
apps.short_description: A Singleplayer Horror Game about navigating an Endless, Living Labyrinth buried in a Mysterious Planet, all whilst facing Dangerous Entities.

apps.name: Arcane Ligature
apps.short_description: Arcane Ligature is a dark fantasy roguelite deckbuilder where you create your own spells by combining runes. Experiment with powerful fusions, master strategic turn-based combat, collect magical relics and battle through an ever-changing world where every run brings new possibilities.

apps.name: Aria's Canvas
apps.short_description: The game follows a character struggling with anxiety and depression, moving through a dark, gloomy world. They collect power-ups representing mental health coping strategies such as exercise, problem solving or humour, gradually making the world brighter and smoother.

apps.name: Ascension Trail: Idle Crusade
apps.short_description: Your heroes fight. You choose the path. Recruit a party from nine roles, gear them up, and pair clashing elements for devastating combos in an idle auto-battler about the decisions between fights.

apps.name: Ashfield Hollow
apps.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

apps.name: Astral Wizards
apps.short_description: Pick a wizard, walk into the swarm and let your spells fire on their own. A neon pixel-art bullet heaven with 30 worlds across 3 galaxies, laws that bend the rules, ENDLESS boss marathons and 13 wizards to master. Evolve 24 weapons into screen-filling light shows. No ads, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Ayakashi Profile
apps.short_description: One button per ally. Chain four fighters’ attacks, special attacks, and spells into launches, follow-ups, and devastating ultimates in this Japanese fantasy battle RPG. Meet a cast of nine, build a party of four, and try the free First Gate demo.

apps.name: Babelled
apps.short_description: Build your way back to space in BABELLED, a co-op tower-building adventure. Stranded on a strange planet, scavenge BABELBLOCKS and stack a path to your spaceship. You and your fellow BABELBOTS must leverage all of their BABELTECH to brave strange sky biomes and build a tower to the heavens.

apps.name: Battlebound Rumble
apps.short_description: Build your warband, pull off ridiculous combos, and show your rivals what perfect build can do! A free-to-play PvP autobattler with 18+ heroes, hundreds of minions, powerful spells, and battles where one brilliant idea can turn the whole match around!

apps.name: Blame Echoes
apps.short_description: Blame Echoes is a first-person psychological horror under a frozen planet in alien ruins. Playing as pilot Adam Lorn, you explore a forgotten complex for your missing wife while facing a presence that somehow already knows you.

apps.name: Blocia
apps.short_description: Blocia is a multiplayer sandbox  MMO where you can build, explore, create games, collect items, customize your character, and connect with players in worlds made by the community.

apps.name: Blood Is Due
apps.short_description: BID: Blood Is Due is a psychological horror roguelite where you face four deadly games of chance. Roll the dice, build your deck, manage Blood, exploit Dealer passives, choose your route, and risk more for greater rewards.

apps.name: Blood Ties - Legacy
apps.short_description: An adult visual novel of vampire politics. Born into one of the Seven bloodlines that rule from the shadows, you’re called home to claim an inheritance everyone wants a piece of. Branching story, a large cast of women with their own agendas, and choices that matter. 18+.

apps.name: BULLETHEART
apps.short_description: In BULLETHEART, every enemy is a bullet. Learn the layouts, master the mechanics, and augment yourself to achieve victory with style.

apps.name: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning
apps.short_description: C.C.C.: Special Cleaning is a third-person bullet hell shooter. Join Cosmo Clean Co.'s Special Cleaning Division, drop onto high-risk planets, and recover the planet cores a former operative stole. Absorb incoming fire, slow the field with Time Dilation, and hit glowing weak points.

apps.name: Can't Escape It
apps.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

apps.name: Car Wash Crew
apps.short_description: Run a roadside car wash solo or with up to 3 friends. Blast mud, spread foam and build new bays by hand. Customers bring cars, buses, rugs—and the occasional house. Follow their tickets, split the work and try to keep your crew out of the soap.

apps.name: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
apps.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

apps.name: Checkpoint '38
apps.short_description: You're a German border guard in 1938. Check passports, catch forged papers, and decide who crosses as the rules tighten. Then go home and face your family. Your job is to obey. Your conscience says otherwise. Free demo on Steam.

apps.name: Choo Choo Kingdom
apps.short_description: The Rift has swallowed the kingdom. Grow one archer’s carriage into a 16-carriage war-train that auto-battles endless hordes. Place troops beside supports for synergy, upgrade a deep skill tree, chase each boss through town and free the kingdom village by village.

apps.name: Chrono Cards
apps.short_description: Chrono Cards is a fast-paced, multiplayer competitive card game where you have the power to bend time itself! Build history-spanning decks and construct explosive, timeline-shattering combos. Exploit endless synergies to shape the timeline in your favor and send your opponent back to the stone age.

apps.name: Clawuuudy
apps.short_description: Your computer only needs one AI desktop pet. Clawuuudy joins you at work with the AI tools you already use, then shares your downtime through chat, care, odd jobs, idle adventures, and AI-powered stories.

apps.name: Colorways
apps.short_description: Colorways is a minimalist traffic management game in which you help colorful traffic navigate various intersections while avoiding traffic jams and accidents. Unique modifiers and daily challenges present ever-changing levels and opportunities to climb the leaderboards.

apps.name: COUNTERSUN
apps.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in 1953, the year a second sun rose. Build a base, mine ore, chop wood, drill for oil and command armies on land, sea and air against the Umbral. Two campaigns, ranked online, skirmish, LAN and a map editor.

apps.name: Crafty Idle
apps.short_description: Crafty Idle is a Minecraft inspired idle RPG where every skill strengthens the rest. Mine and craft your way to the strongest gear, take down monsters that each have their own weakness to exploit, and optimize your farming by chasing down the best genes. Progress never stops, even offline.

apps.name: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
apps.short_description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

apps.name: CTRL+ALT+BURN
apps.short_description: Keep the company online. Avoid the boss. CTRL+ALT+BURN is a chaotic co-op IT game for 1 to 6 players: reboot crashed servers, swap dead disks, answer the helpdesk, put out the microwave fire and climb a 60-floor office tower, one shift at a time.

apps.name: Damashi Game
apps.short_description: A thrilling multiplayer experience where social deception, strategy, and quick thinking are your greatest weapons. Outsmart your opponents and be the last player standing in this intense fight for survival.

apps.name: DOOM 3: Phobos
apps.short_description: Waking up on Mars with no memory and a wound you can’t explain, you begin a desperate search for answers - about yourself, your past, and the catastrophe looming over two worlds.

apps.name: Drachenquell
apps.short_description:
Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt.
Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

apps.name: Dungeon Janitor
apps.short_description: Clean up the messy dungeon, collect and recycle resources and find forgotten loot in this active incremental “chore-like”. Dispose of dead bodies, broken artillery and left-over treasure, wipe the bloody floors and slay the remaining monsters to ready the dungeon for its next great battle.

apps.name: DungeonBox
apps.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

apps.name: Edgefield
apps.short_description: Edgefield is a mix of the adult visual novel, dating sim and point-and-click adventure genres with a wide and colorful cast of characters to meet, befriend, and romance (in fully animated scenes) as you make your way through your freshman year at Edgefield University.

apps.name: Eldkin
apps.short_description: Cosy creature-collecting in a living pixel world. Bond with and evolve over 130 kin, battle side by side in real time and ride them through sky, sea and lava. Flood caves, burn forests and blast tunnels with your kin, alone or with up to three friends, and face six titans to restore the sun.

apps.name: Elfscape: Ancestors
apps.short_description: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.

apps.name: Elk, Grove's Last Guard
apps.short_description: Defend the sacred grove against an endless wave of living shadows. Fight the horde with a horde of your own creation, wield strange powers, and survive increasingly chaotic battles from every direction.

apps.name: Emory Cole & The Secret at Greymar Point
apps.short_description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

apps.name: Evacuation
apps.short_description: Evacuation is an unofficial story-driven add-on for Half-life 2, telling the story of an rebel who crashes on a helicopter in the woods. Having miraculously survived, the hero picks up a walkie-talkie and decides to escape from the forest, which was attacked by the Combine.

apps.name: Farwoods
apps.short_description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

apps.name: FerroFrame
apps.short_description: FerroFrame is a real-time strategy  ecology simulator — dig, dam, redirect and blast industry into high gear, then survive the world as the balance tilts in either direction. Use gigantic mechs called frames to terraform the planet to your needs and replenish your world with asteroids!

apps.name: Final Tactics
apps.short_description: This is a f2p online tactical turn based strategy 1v1 grid-based pvp game (with pve) and infinite replayability; you can play this the rest of your life. There are 140+ BALANCED units with move/attack and 4 abilities, & i'll always be adding more. Use your entire army every turn. No P2W, pure skill.

apps.name: Flame Cycle
apps.short_description: FlameCycle is a brutal, ultra-minimalist open-world soulslike. Start at the bottom of the food chain, build an infinite deck of combat abilities, and adapt as the world radically metamorphoses with every single death.

apps.name: Football Star Life ! 26/27
apps.short_description: Create your player, prove yourself season after season, sign for new clubs, represent your country and compete for football’s greatest trophies. Every performance shapes your future, every decision changes your path, and every career tells a different story

apps.name: Fox7: City Of Fighters
apps.short_description: Explore 10 cities, build your fighter through boxing, kickboxing, wrestling and MMA, then battle using strategic cards, submissions and whatever the street puts within reach. Rise from bar fights and underground pits to become king of the cage.

apps.name: FrontierCraft
apps.short_description: FrontierCraft is a massively multiplayer sandbox set on one vast, fully destructible planet. Twenty kingdoms, thousands of ruins, and every player in the same world. Mine, build, trade and fight. Help kingdoms rise or fall, raise your clan's banner and carve out your place on the frontier.

apps.name: Fruit Kombat
apps.short_description: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.

apps.name: Furthia Trails
apps.short_description: Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. Meet Liam, the Doggaroo. After a cliffside tumble, he finds himself lost in the mysterious Goomshi Forest - a wild and dangerous place full of strange, alluring creatures with their own instincts.

apps.name: Galanost
apps.short_description: A cozy co-op village game for 1 to 8 players. Welcome new neighbors, build your village together and fill the tavern at night. Meet the island's wildlife and live through every season. At the bottom of the old mine, a sealed door waits.

apps.name: Gang
apps.short_description: Five rival gangs. One city. One turf war waiting to explode. Shoot your way through ever-changing streets with an arsenal of ridiculous weapons. Blast enemies with bread, fire books like cannonballs, and send rival bosses to their knees. It's a dog-eat-dog world. Good thing your boss is a cat.

apps.name: GeneJinks: Sports Festival
apps.short_description: Breed unusual creatures, build skill loadouts and take direct control in seven sports events, from arena clashes to forest races. Play solo or host an online game so friends can join over the internet and compete together.

apps.name: Godborne: Ashes of Ramessu
apps.short_description: A first‑person tower defense hybrid where you summon towers that fight off waves of enemies while you solve the puzzles of the ancient ruins around you.

apps.name: Gold Admiral
apps.short_description: Explore, trade, research, and fight across a turn-based naval strategy sandbox. Found coastal cities, command fleets and armies, clear pirate hideouts and dungeons, and shape each campaign through economy, diplomacy, or conquest.

apps.name: GRIDDLE 66
apps.short_description: GRIDDLE 66 is a hands-on fast-food job simulator. Grill burgers, prepare fries and drinks, serve customers, and clean up after each shift. Work solo or in 2-player online co-op, sharpen your skills, and rise from part-timer to the Hall of Fame.

apps.name: Happily Never After
apps.short_description: Happily Never After is a low-poly retro adventure with psychological horror elements set in a surreal, distorted Lebanon. Drive through eerie streets, solve unsettling puzzles, and survive everyday absurdities turned nightmarish as you uncover the dark secrets of a corrupted reality.

apps.name: Haunted Echoes
apps.short_description: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.

apps.name: Hedge-Wizard Cocktail
apps.short_description: A not-so-cozy apothecary simulator. Explore, gather reagents, craft wicked concoctions and haggle with adventurers, alone or with friends, in a dangerous, dark fantasy world. Complete quests and expand your alchemical expertise to grow your shop before the horrors of the Hedge destroy you.

apps.name: Heroes of the Forgotten Land
apps.short_description: A Norse fantasy tower defense. Build and upgrade five tower types, lead heroes into battle, forge runes and rebuild your village as you push back the darkness across forest, frost and fire. Twelve chapters, three game modes.

apps.name: Hey, Izumi, Watch This!
apps.short_description: It is a visual novel game about two women. The protagonist, who is a university student, goes for a walk late at night. An unknown woman points a gun at the protagonist and asks her whether she will follow her or not. After following her, they decide to live outdoors together for a while, but...

apps.name: Hikki Life
apps.short_description: A story-driven action-adventure about a shut-in who flees people into video games. A talking cat leads him to a parallel world, where he fights in a dungeon, grows stronger, seeks his missing grandfather, and regains his memories. But the further he goes, the less that world looks like the truth.

apps.name: Hollow Galley
apps.short_description: When deep-sea research vessel goes silent above a hydrothermal vent field, Rin Kessler docks alone to find her missing brother. Manage scarce ammunition against mutated crew members and unearth the Nocturne program in this hand-drawn, anime cel-shaded third-person survival horror mystery.

apps.name: Home Before Dusk
apps.short_description: Farm, cook and fall in love in a fenced town at the end of the world. Once a week, a helicopter flies you out to abandoned towns for fuel, medicine and parts. Search fast and get back on board before dusk: the pilots don't wait for anyone.

apps.name: HONKSHOT
apps.short_description: HONKSHOT is a fast-paced arcade car-combat game where you drift, jump, and blast your way to ten eliminations in four-car Deathmatch! Play online with friends, practice solo against bots, or take on 20-car Weapon Race and Junkyard Royale.

apps.name: Hordebound
apps.short_description: A 3D co-op survivor roguelike for 1 to 4 players. Pick a champion, run and slide through a horde of hundreds, stack auto-firing weapons into absurd builds, beat the boss and get out alive. Seven biomes, 29 champions, and a horde to destory.

apps.name: House of Wardians: Unchained
apps.short_description: Recruit, customize and evolve your Wardians, then send them into fast automatic battles where strategy is decided before the fight. Combine species, classes, weapons, skills and guardian spirits into your perfect build, and climb seasonal leagues against other players' Wardians.

apps.name: HoverShot
apps.short_description: Shooting is the only way to move. Master zero-gravity combat where every shot is both movement and attack. Experiment with weapons and stackable items that change how you fight and move. Unlock new characters and abilities as you battle through each roguelite run.

apps.name: Idle Harmony
apps.short_description:
An idle game where you build compositions to earn money. Unlock notes, chords, instruments & effects then evolve your melody. 
Experiment and make the next big hit, export & share it anywhere!

apps.name: Idle Primes
apps.short_description: A cursed incremental horror game with PSX-style graphics. Find a strange CD-ROM, boot it on your bedroom computer, and click prime numbers to buy upgrades and automate the search, while something on the other side of the screen takes an interest in you. ████████████████████ Belphegor's ██████!

apps.name: Inside Job
apps.short_description: Escape prison in co-op with 1–4 players – or survive LAST COUNT with up to 10: no teams, deadly games, only one walks out. Work the inmates, trade, gamble, and pick your moment.

apps.name: It's Always Grey: Serial Detective Stories
apps.short_description: It's Always Grey is a detective mystery serial, inspired by real true crime cases. In a city of perpetual rain, Detective Molly Grey investigates a horrific discovery made years after the crime took place. Search for clues, highlight critical evidence, and connect the dots to find those responsible.

apps.name: KINGDOM OF REQUIEM
apps.short_description:
"The truth sits under a mountain of lies and deception..."

KINGDOM OF REQUIEM is a royal drama-based fantasy visual novel following the lives of various royals, their courts, and the embittered emperor who threatens to upend their lives.

apps.name: Land of Manifestations: Sanctuary
apps.short_description: A fantasy RPG blending romance, roguelite shooting, and city building. Awakening in the Tianwen Temple with no memory of the past, you discover that an unknown force is corrupting the Land of Manifestations, twisting Xiangling into monsters. To save the world, you must build a Sanctuary.

apps.name: Lavender's
apps.short_description: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

apps.name: Life of a caveman
apps.short_description:
Live the colorful life of a caveman. 
Eat and interact with other cavemen in order to grow stronger and smarter. 
Once you are strong enough, become the leader of your group and guide them to safety; 
safety from things like the the beast that attacks at night and the other tribe that left tracks in your area.

apps.name: Lola's Familiars
apps.short_description: Escape a demonic underworld prison in this stunning anime inspired lite-vania adventure. Explore mysterious magical realms, forge pacts with powerful Familiar bosses, uncover dark secrets, and guide Lola through an emotional journey of growth in a haunting dark fantasy world.

apps.name: Magic Castle: Tidy Up The Kingdom
apps.short_description: Wield a magic wand and rebuild a scattered fairy-tale castle piece by piece in this cozy first-person game. Charm stones into place, sweep away rubble, earn upgrades and restore five enchanted halls, alone or in online co-op with up to 4 mages.

apps.name: Mall Chaos
apps.short_description: The mall is closed, and your shift has just begun. Explore a multi-floor shopping mall in first person, pick up scattered products, and return them to the right shelves, tables, and racks.

apps.name: Manabies
apps.short_description: Embark on an action adventure across floating islands where magical creatures, fast-paced arena battles, and an ever-growing flying base hide a unique twist: every battle is powered by real mathematics, helping you become smarter with every challenge.

apps.name: Matter of State
apps.short_description: Boil, freeze, melt and condense matter on its way across small island boards, in as few parts as you can. 184 puzzles, a new one every day, and a level editor with Workshop sharing.

apps.name: Melted Valor: The Plastic Crusade
apps.short_description: The Green Army replaced them. Now the Tan want their plastic back. Fight through a brutal single-player third-person campaign as a desperate toy war erupts from the shelves into the human world. Every toy, insect and machine is dragged into the conflict.

apps.name: Memory Games Squirrels
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Mind’s Judgment
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. You wake in a hotel whose hallways repeat endlessly, never quite the same. Inspect every object, decipher its clues, and unravel its puzzles while something stalks you from the shadows. What you unearth will shape the verdict that awaits you.

apps.name: Minimalist Industry Tycoon
apps.short_description: Minimalist Farm Tycoon is a resource management game. Grow crops, raise livestock, research upgrades, build factories and produce goods. Turn a failing farm into a profitable business.

apps.name: Mondrayn
apps.short_description: Mondrayn is a grim JRPG with survival elements where dying doesn't mean the end of your suffering. Dig into the remnants of a dead world, exterminate monsters, craft your gear. Help yourself and other restless souls make their way to Anthrum.

apps.name: Mothville: A City of Hidden Things
apps.short_description: The residents of Mothville are always losing things and need the help of someone with eagle eyes! Explore the town’s diverse neighborhoods, talk to the animal residents, complete their quests, and find everything that’s gone missing in this wacky, story-driven hidden object game.

apps.name: Mount Tartarus
apps.short_description: Survive the underworld in Mount Tartarus, a bullet heaven roguelite. Cut through endless monster hordes and combine skills and passives into devastating builds. Every run earns gold for permanent upgrades, so each death makes you stronger. Besides, where else would you go? You are already dead.

apps.name: Multiverse Survivors
apps.short_description: Unlock every universe, then field heroes and skills from different worlds together — dream matchups no history would allow. Einstein raises havoc in the Heavenly Court. Ancient generals hand-build an atom bomb. Odin opens fire with a gun. Sun Wukong fights aliens, and more.

apps.name: My Beautiful Aquarium
apps.short_description: A fish tank that lives on your screen. Real species, and every fish is an individual you can name. In Cozy mode nothing can die, so you can leave it running all day. Challenge mode is proper fishkeeping: water types, breeding, sickness, mistakes. Play it, or just let it swim.

apps.name: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
apps.short_description:
One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city...

Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

apps.name: My Time at Evershine
apps.short_description: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

apps.name: No Shot
apps.short_description: Launch into a zero-gravity arena and execute with your team in a fast-paced and intense sport only possible in virtual reality.

apps.name: NodeFeat
apps.short_description: Still reading? The black tide is back. No bones, no end. You don't build a base: you grow one, a mutant tree of concrete and steel, hungry for death. Order its branches, rewrite the ground, grind them to paste. There is no future. There is the wall.

apps.name: NS Drive Simulator
apps.short_description: A driving simulator featuring realistic driving, diverse vehicles, and multiple driving environments.

apps.name: OKTORAID
apps.short_description: Survive the AI robot uprising, solo or with a friend on one couch. Scavenge scrap, build a turret fortress, then auto-blast endless hordes in a roguelite siege, while the live power cable that ties you together fries every robot that crosses it.

apps.name: PaleBlueRose
apps.short_description: Pale Blue Rose is a free-to-play online medieval city builder with real-time war. Grow a town from a founding wagon, master production chains, trade with up to 10,000 players and conquer rivals on one seamless world. Win by reaching 90% of the world's yearly economy.

apps.name: Phylactery Slayer
apps.short_description: A soulslike roguelike where every pixel of the world is destructible. Play solo, with your team, or face invading enemy squads. Four online modes, from solo runs to PvP arena. Each death leaves a phylactery that remembers your power.

apps.name: Pinetrail
apps.short_description: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

apps.name: Portal Reloaded
apps.short_description: Portal Reloaded is a free, community made modification for Portal 2. The mod builds on the concepts of the main game by allowing you to place a third portal, which enables traveling between two different timelines. Thinking in four dimensions is vital to solving 25 brand new mind-bending puzzles.

apps.name: Portal: System Failure
apps.short_description: Portal: System Failure is an upcoming fan-made mod that expands upon the Portal universe with all-new puzzles and a darker narrative, all to deliver an epic singleplayer campaign. This new, full-length campaign will feature a carefully crafted story with new characters, and a unique soundtrack.

apps.name: Pull Over!
apps.short_description: A co-op detective horror game set at a roadside militia checkpoint in 1991. Check papers, search cars and make quota by morning. Some of the drivers aren't human. Spot them and shoot first

apps.name: Radar Shadow
apps.short_description: Somewhere on the other half of the map is the enemy's base. You don't know which hex it's on, and they don't know where yours is. No soldiers to click on: you run a country's radars, air defence and drone strikes, and design every drone and missile yourself.

apps.name: Rat Hunt
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game: a swarm of tiny rats must outlast hungry hawks in a giant backyard. The twist? Moving gives you away, so freeze to vanish in the grass. Whisper to friends with proximity voice... if you dare. Get caught and you JOIN the hunt.

apps.name: Redacted by the Sadistic Princess from Another World?!
apps.short_description: Socially awkward game developer Yaemori Nowa receives more than she bargains for when two characters she created for her indie smash hit eroge, Utter Obedience: Conquered by the Sadistic Princess, appear in her apartment. What's a hopeless lesbian to do?!

apps.name: Reel Bad Fishing
apps.short_description: A washed-up fisherman, a debt to a mermaid, and an island chain full of gangs, gamblers and sea monsters. Fish with traps, sonar and a revolver, scratch off tickets for legendary catches, and shoot, scheme and gamble your way to the top of the worst sea in the world.

apps.name: Revenge Crystal Project
apps.short_description: Awaken in a fallen knight’s body, kept alive by a mysterious living crystal. Explore a ruined world with top-down Soulslike combat, elemental magic, and Metroidvania progression. You are not the knight—you are the will driving him.

apps.name: ROBOSCAV
apps.short_description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

apps.name: RSP Ultimate Battle
apps.short_description: Rock-paper-scissors meets strategic card autobattling! Collect and merge cards, build your team, and outsmart opponents through positioning, elemental matchups, unique abilities, and spells.

apps.name: Rúnafall
apps.short_description: A retro-styled co-op action roguelike in Viking-age Norway. Raid as one of five black-metal Vikings, carve through draugr, trolls and corpse-ravens, and topple the monsters who rule three cursed regions, to an original industrial metal score by Norway's Melt Motif. Solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Safe at Dawn
apps.short_description: Supernatural events are taking place throughout the night. Keep a close watch on all the rooms and don't overlook even the smallest detail. Try to make it through the night, either alone, with the help of other players, or by competing against them. Will you be safe at dawn?

apps.name: Siege Protocol
apps.short_description: Siege Protocol is a multiplayer first-person melee combat game where robots clash in team-based battles and competitive game modes. Fight with melee weapons and abilities, take control of objectives, and customize your robot.

apps.name: Slutopia
apps.short_description: Slutopia is a modern utopia centered around a luxurious dream villa! The most beautiful and liberated girls are waiting for you: an office siren, a sexy nurse, and other hot employees. Build your own debauched mansion and form the tightest relationships with your subordinates!

apps.name: Snake Echos
apps.short_description: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

apps.name: Solaro
apps.short_description: Explore space like an alien. Solaro is an experimental adventure game where you guide a tiny traveller through a vast galaxy of puzzles and trials.

apps.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults
apps.short_description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

apps.name: Spektr
apps.short_description: Spektr is an asymmetrical online horror game where the objective is simple, haunt or be hunted. Enter a multidimensional battle with up to 4 friends. One of you will randomly be selected to become a ghost, and the rest of you will have to track down and expel the ghost from the physical realm.

apps.name: STEP THEATER
apps.short_description:
WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) 
“STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

apps.name: Stillwater: Coastal Maine
apps.short_description: Make yourself at home on the Maine coast. Explore an old captain's house, read by the window, fish from the dock, and look for sea glass along the tide line. Choose the season, weather, and time of day, or watch a storm come in off the Atlantic. A quiet place to return to at your own pace.

apps.name: Stormtide Skies
apps.short_description: Take command of a steam-powered airship and battle across the storm-torn skies. Fight solo, challenge AI, compete online, experience a cinematic story, or survive the relentless waves and colossal bosses of Redwake Siege.

apps.name: Strike Commander
apps.short_description: It's 2011, you command Stern’s Wildcats, an elite squadron of mercenaries trying to fly straight in a world of deceit and violence. Pilot advanced aircraft as you engage rival squadrons and the armies of the dreaded IRS.

apps.name: Suffer Together
apps.short_description: A 2-player online co-op comedy horror game. Describe symbols to your partner and defend yourself against deadly animatronics to win Stella’s game show!

apps.name: Sunny Trails
apps.short_description: Sunny Trails is a cozy turn-based RPG. Amaterasu and her sisters travel to a party on a paradisiacal Brazilian island, only to find all the guests turned to stone. Fish, decorate your camp, and explore the island to discover who petrified your friends!

apps.name: Super Optimal Amount of Punching
apps.short_description: Punch everything. Learn nothing. Lord Evil's shining nipples await you.

apps.name: Take One Down
apps.short_description: Ninety-nine bottles of beer on the wall. You know how it goes. Take one down, pass it around, and keep the Singer company at the bar. He's sung this song more times than he can count, and lately it's starting to sound a little strange.

apps.name: The Death Night Show
apps.short_description: The Death Night Show is a narrative game with multiple endings and unlockable scenes where you play as Death's intern in his own late night show. Control the audience's reactions to the events of the program, run errands, and uncover the overarching mystery with each new featured guest.

apps.name: The Deep Waits
apps.short_description: You have one minute to live. Eat, explore, fight, and craft your way off a cursed island before the deep takes you.

apps.name: The Last Delivery
apps.short_description: Working the night shift at a remote roadside diner was supposed to just pay the bills. Instead, you're thrown into a web of strange patrons, unsolved disappearances, and a shadowy serial killer. Search the dark. Solve the past. Survive the shift.

apps.name: The Little Cloud
apps.short_description: You’re a little cloud with a big job. Soar over the cozy seaside town of Peace Wind Bay as its newest sky courier: deliver parcels, give rides, and rain on the places that need it most. Make friends, bring wilted fields back to life, and on Rainbow Day, paint the sky for everyone.

apps.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
apps.short_description: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

apps.name: The Singularity
apps.short_description: Face your friends in a futuristic/cyberpunk card game where each card unleashes a different kind of chaos. Manage to keep the Singularity in your hand until the end to be the winner. Establish the Singularity at the end of the game and disconnect your opponents. Are you ready?

apps.name: The Winner 2 - The Reality Show
apps.short_description: Experience what it's like to participate in a reality show in this casual, immersive, and fun simulator! Enter a medieval castle, compete for the title of ultimate winner, and enjoy a unique experience with an original soundtrack and fun 2D graphics.

apps.name: The Yield
apps.short_description: A minimalistic dystopian inspector simulator. Inspect packages, verify data, and log violations on your work sheet. Every mistake or delay brings you closer to a shift failure. Don't let the timer catch you off guard.

apps.name: Titan Hunters
apps.short_description: Grab your friends, load the cannons, and defend your castle from giant monsters in this chaotic 1-4 player physics-based co-op game. Blast massive Titans apart piece by piece, upgrade your weapons, and try not to blow up your own base!

apps.name: Tithe
apps.short_description: Build a deathtrap arena. Raid someone else’s. Tithe is a dark-fantasy action raider where you design trap-filled gauntlets for other players to survive, then fight through theirs, and through the vaults, hideouts and ruins of Pheran, where everyone owes someone.

apps.name: Torchline
apps.short_description: The sun has fallen asleep. Carry the last ember of daylight in a single torch and lead a column of four east to the Tower of the Sleeping Sun. A fairy-tale, turn-based party RPG where your marching order is your formation — and whoever holds the torch decides what you see.

apps.name: Undercrown: Protect the Deadland
apps.short_description: Dig a living dungeon, grow a hungry ecosystem of monsters and hide the Dungeon Lord from waves of human heroes. Thirty years after losing the throne, Albert returns - and this time the arena is underground.

apps.name: Undersea: Waves and Adventures
apps.short_description: You are the captain of a submarine of a small Ukrainian island state, with a big baggage of dreams and a lot of problems. Sink enemy ships, explore mysterious abandoned bases, steal secret documents. Drink tea and don't forget to have fun. Your team is already waiting for you. To the Battle!

apps.name: Unextinct
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic online evolution game. Wake up as a cloned microbe at the bottom of a drowned world and evolve into a virus, a predator or something new. 180+ evolution paths, 90+ locations, riddle quests and real-time PvP with other players.

apps.name: Urban Echoes
apps.short_description: Urban Echoes is a relaxing skateboarding game demo with stylish retro graphics that encourages exploration, individuality, and self-discovery.

apps.name: VOXHELL
apps.short_description: You are the subject. He is the experiment. Forty-eight rooms of traps designed to test not your reflexes, but your behavior, while a smug narrator comments on every mistake. And when you need a break, there's a whole other game waiting on the computer.

apps.name: Wholesaler Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own wholesale business in Wholesaler Simulator! Negotiate with producers, stock products in your warehouse, and fulfill online orders. Upgrade your warehouse, hire workers, and buy new vehicles. Manage deliveries and grow your business in this realistic trading simulation!

apps.name: Wildsite
apps.short_description: Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

apps.name: WonderPaws
apps.short_description: Welcome to WonderPaws! Where a city is built by animals! Here Paw Pals run shops, make friends, and chase their dreams. You, a newly arrived human, get a whimsical new life: share a home with Paw Pals, decorate it, become a star, mayor, or designer… or turn into a Paw Pal yourself and try it all!

apps.name: YOUR DEAD WEIGHT
apps.short_description: Asymmetric co-op horror-comedy for up to 6 players. Move the furniture out before time runs out, or become the thing that won't let it leave.

apps.name: 巡查員：異常報告
apps.short_description: Memorize things and look for anomalies, but you have to keep walking around in the scene. At the end of a level, there will even be a huge monster chasing you, and by the time you finish a level, half your fingers will be sore.

apps.name: Breadcrumbs: Still Here Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Original soundtrack for video game Breadcrumbs: Still Here

apps.name: Clustertruck OST
apps.short_description: Support indie composers by buying the official Clustertruck OST, featuring 13 trucks from the infamous truck-jumping platformer

apps.name: DAVE THE DIVER Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Dive back into the Blue Hole with the official DAVE THE DIVER Original Soundtrack. Relive every unforgettable moment, from peaceful underwater exploration to late-night sushi bar rushes and wild adventures. Bring Dave's journey and atmosphere wherever you go.

apps.name: Deadline Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The music in Deadline is designed to completely pull you into its world. From haunting, atmospheric soundscapes that underscore your exploration to pulse-pounding tracks during intense encounters, every piece of audio is crafted to elevate the emotional weight of your journey.

apps.name: State of Decay: Original Game Soundtrack
apps.short_description: This companion to the 2013 hit game State of Decay contains 21 tracks of original game music by award-winning composer Jesper Kyd and Undead Labs audio director Kevin Patzelt.

apps.name: State of Decay: Year-One Survival Edition Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official Year-One Survival Edition soundtrack is a companion to the original game soundtrack and contains 17 additional tracks of game music by award-winning composer Jesper Kyd.

apps.name: BFG Unlocked Against All Odds: BFG Unlocked Against All Odds – Fade to Silence Docmentary
apps.short_description: Black Forest Games is about to release their new game on Early Access. There is only one slot left and time is running out. But then unexpected problems occur. Join the development team of BFG on their journey from the game's announcement until the first updates of 'Fade to Silence'.

apps.name: The Making of Horizon Zero Dawn: Mathijs De Jonge Extended Interview
apps.short_description: In this extended cut of our interview with Horizon Zero Dawn's Director Mathijs De Jonge, we talk about the long process of crafting the game from initial pitch to boxed release.
